deliverables: custodial wallet onboarding for Sellout users
public launch campaign and trade-show activations
public metrics dashboard and quarterly reporting
request.recipient: Anvil Development Agency, Inc. / Intersect as budget administrator
request.what: Fund Phase 2 of a production Cardano-native ticketing platform operated by Sellout.io and built by Anvil Development Agency.

claims.claim: Phase 1 is already live on Cardano mainnet with on-chain event creation, CIP-68 ticket minting, transfers, and attendance verification funded by Sellout with over $130,000 of its own capital.
The withdrawal requests 4,969,231 ada, approximately $1,093,231 at $0.22 per ADA, including a 3% Intersect administration fee over 8 months with milestone-gated disbursement.
Phase 2 will deliver a secondary marketplace, royalty enforcement, anti-scalping controls, wallet onboarding, organizer tools, an independent audit, and launch marketing.

The proposal commits to repay $1,093,231 to the Cardano Treasury through a revenue-share mechanism of 25% of fees until reimbursement and 5% thereafter, with final revenue-base definition and cadence to be established in M1 contracting.
Sellout has 200,000+ registered users, has issued 250,000+ tickets to date, and runs 350+ events annually at current cadence.
The proposal targets 200+ events on-chain, 75,000+ NFT tickets, 150,000+ on-chain interactions, $6,000,000+ ticket revenue on-chain, and 20,000+ new wallets within 12 months from launch.
The Yellowstone Club 2026 concert series is presented as a contracted anchor deployment expected to move more than $6 million through Cardano in Year 1, based on $5.88 million 2025 historical volume.
All on-chain metrics are planned to be independently verifiable via Cardano explorer data, policy-ID tracking, a public dashboard in M5, and quarterly Cardano Forum reports.
Intersect is described as budget administrator using the Sundae Labs TRSC/PSSC framework with an external oversight committee and public dashboard for on-chain auditability.
Anvil/Sellout state they have not received ada from the Cardano Treasury within the last 24 months.

summary: The document requests 4,969,231 ada for an 8-month, milestone-gated Phase 2 build of a Cardano-native ticketing marketplace with claimed existing mainnet Phase 1, Sellout adoption base, revenue-share repayment, Intersect administration, and public reporting commitments.
